title: Mentorship from Industry Leaders
description: Learn directly from internationally acclaimed corporate leaders, adjunct faculty members, and professors of practice. Gain firsthand insights into industry trends and expertise from top professionals.

bullets.label: Free Laptop
bullets.text: Every Management student is equipped with a complimentary laptop, ensuring seamless access to digital resources.

bullets.label: Certifications
bullets.text: Choose from 15 diverse certification courses, spanning all management domains, to stay ahead in your field.
Dual specialization options and the flexibility of major/minor combinations customized to your career goals.
Comprehensive curriculum blending theoretical knowledge with practical applications, designed to cater to key areas of interest.

bullets.label: International Excursion Trips
bullets.text: Meritorious students enjoy trips abroad, exploring global industries and academic institutions.

bullets.label: International Exchange Programs
bullets.text: Tie-ups with prestigious universities offer unparalleled global exposure.
Scholarships for outstanding students, based on academic performance and competitive exam scores like MAT, CAT, XAT, and CMAT.
Easy fee installment plans to ensure affordability.
40% of each course is taught by experienced industry experts.
Industrial visits to leading companies like Parle, Oppo, Coca-Cola, Amul, Yakult, and more, offering hands-on learning experiences.
Summer internships for a minimum of 6 months with Pre-Placement Offers (PPOs).
Live projects, HR talk series, and specialization conclaves hosted by industry veterans.
Dedicated placement cell connecting students to top-tier companies across sectors.
Live projects (7–15 days) to immerse students in real-world industry environments.
Guaranteed final placements aligning with students' interests and aspirations.

title: Holistic Development for Future Leaders
description: Beyond academics, our program focuses on leadership, entrepreneurship, communication, and soft skills development to prepare students for every challenge in their professional journey.
